Research edition · 5 November 2026

Five stocks. One risk budget. No established edge.

A $1,000 research comparison with actual plugin Sharpe, conditional Kelly and convexity calculations, plus Page diagnostics. Computation is not approval; model inputs are not observed future outcomes.

Research conclusion

The core plugin has now actually run. Equal dollars have higher historical Sharpe than inverse volatility on this sample; conditional Kelly and convexity outputs are shown with their inputs and formula bindings.

Strongest objection

The resampling model reuses a bullish two-year history. Binary payoff compression produces uncapped Kelly fractions that fail a full-path log-domain check; capped arithmetic still does not establish a prospective edge.

Key uncertainty

Conditional positive Kelly references are calculated, not authorized or calibrated. Three tail fits reject, company valuation coverage is incomplete, quarterly cash-flow counterevidence remains, and gasoline quotes are non-coherent.

Next evidence check

Run held-out or rolling tests with costs, inspect full filings and cash conversion, and establish explicit forward return/payoff assumptions before reconsidering exposure.

Sizing and risk constraints

Actual core-plugin calculations · conditional inputs

Run the engine. Then challenge its assumptions.

calculate under modeled inputs. All five stocks now have actual Sharpe, Kelly and convexity outputs from the installed plugin. These are calculated values—not section labels, calibrated forecasts or approval to trade.

modeled · Editorial reading

A number is not permission

Positive Kelly references are calculated under an in-sample model, not calibrated forward stock odds or approval to deploy capital.

Native calculations under model inputs; standalone caps are not combined portfolio weights

The input model is not a validated edge. Kelly/convexity use 4,000 joint historical moving-block trials: 500 retained returns, 252-session horizon, 21-session blocks, fixed seed 20261105. Shared blocks preserve contemporaneous dependence. Stationarity, drift, block choice and a bullish sample drive these conditional outputs; valuation and forward calibration remain missing.

Full-path domain check: the installed plugin also tested expected log growth on all 4,000 retained paths. Every uncapped binary-Kelly fraction leaves nonpositive wealth on some retained tail path; the full-distribution log calculation is unavailable there. Capped references have valid log domains in those sampled paths. This does not certify unseen tails or turn the binary fraction into a joint/full-distribution optimum.

Kelly sequence: full × 0.50 confidence multiplier × 0.25 Kelly fraction, then a 30% standalone stock cap. These are analyst illustration choices, not user-selected or approved constraints. Full fractions above 1 are theoretical references, not permission to borrow. Native warning text calls the cap a “user cap”; that is engine wording, not proof the user chose it.

The p/g/l inputs are conditional resampling assumptions; not calibrated stock success odds

The native inverse-volatility portfolio case gives a sleeve reference of97.16%. Its actual dollar output is floored to cents, then apportioned across the original relative weights; $28.36 remains cash. This is not joint Kelly optimization, not a validated recommendation and not authenticated approval. It does not relabel the original risk-only weights as Kelly weights.

The new arithmetic changes the comparison: equal dollars have higher historical Sharpe than inverse volatility on this same sample, despite higher volatility. Lower volatility alone did not establish better risk-adjusted return. Neither in-sample result establishes future superiority.

03

Business model · counterevidence

Growth is not the same as cash conversion

measured — company-reported, limited scope. The primary checks below are separate context, not inputs to the price-history fits. Negative quarterly cash flow remains visible: a familiar platform is not automatically a current cash-flow refuge. These definitions and periods are not fully comparable; no audited valuation conclusion follows.

modeled · Editorial reading

The cash question

Growth alone does not settle cash conversion, capital intensity or valuation. Read the negative quarterly figures alongside the coverage gaps.

For META and GOOG, test whether distribution advantages survive capital intensity and competitive change. For CRWD, inspect retention, customer economics and cash conversion; for AVGO, inspect customer concentration and investment-cycle exposure. Those are research questions—not findings established by this price dataset. No complete five-company filings review or reverse DCF has run.

04

Macro · explicit horizons

Markets price events, not your portfolio

measured quotes → forecasted events. Canonical raw API observations are from 15:53 UTC on November 5; browser captures have their own later timestamps and UI rounding. No normalization, calibrated probability claim or joint macro forecast was applied. Release delays can invoke contract-specific fallback rules; inspect the linked terms. BLS calendar retrieval was 403, so its release times below are contract-specified, not independently calendar-verified.

modeled · Editorial reading

Do not repair the market

Raw bucket prices are not a calibrated joint forecast. The gasoline book remains non-coherent; the largest quote is not a reliable direction probability.

Fed direction: summed raw quoted buckets favor hike 67.25%, versus hold 30.50% and cut 1.20%. Total 98.95%, unnormalized. This is contract-price arithmetic, not a stock win probability or all-in executable odds.

GDP, jobs, CPI and next-day gasoline have different horizons; no causal stock sensitivities or joint event probabilities were estimated. No Bayesian prior was supplied and no source was promoted to user_verified, so no belief update was applied.

Risk · survivability

The downside does not disappear at smaller size

calculate — MODEL-F01 / MODEL-F02. All five use 501 completed adjusted-price bars and 500 daily returns, November 5, 2024 through November 4, 2026. Actual execution · fit before inference

Two useful models—and a boundary they cannot cross

modeled — Page is upstream mathematics, not a ninth investor. The live-data harness directly reused the frozen power-law, Markov and claim-compiler kernels. It did not run a forward decision overlay, generate a user-approved decision record or test a provider-backed LLM conversation. Parent replay checked 55 hashed files and exact results; eight model tests passed, with independent arithmetic checks.

Three tail fits reject at the declared threshold. Non-rejection is not proof; neither model supplies positive sizing authorization.

Conditional stress · no manufactured EV

Convexity calculated, uncertainty retained

calculate under modeled scenarios — actual native convexity engine. This replaces the earlier uniform-shock-only placeholder. The plugin calculates probability-weighted upside/downside, breakeven probability, expected P&L and scenario asymmetry. It is not option gamma and these are not issuer price targets.

Do not confuse a mean with a limit

Native scenario max_loss is a compressed bad-state mean, not the worst resampled path or the maximum possible loss. Payoff asymmetry is not option gamma.

Account boundary

No leverage assumed. No account accessed.

modeled: borrowing is assumed $0 in this hypothetical test; leverage is not used. This is not a measurement of an actual account. Broker maintenance, liquidation thresholds, financing rates and personal balances are unavailable, so the margin engine was not run. No missing broker field was assigned a reassuring invented value.

10

Missing input · no synthetic chain

Options were not collected

No options chain, expiration, strike, premium, spread or liquidity snapshot was retrieved. Options valuation and strategy sizing are unavailable; no options position is assumed. Missing chain evidence does not imply free optionality.

Portfolio interactions · implementation limits

Weights can organize risk. They cannot manufacture an edge.

calculate — MODEL-F05. All observed pairwise correlations are positive; they range 0.283–0.485 on this sample. Five tickers do not establish five independent risk sources, and crisis dependence may rise. No causal business-factor exposure or hedge effectiveness was estimated.

modeled — not a true defensive barbell. The constrained universe has no Treasury/cash sleeve beyond rounding residuals. Inverse volatility is a risk-only rule, not risk parity or valuation. The 30% cap is a chosen limit and does not bind the current sample. Full-sample weights evaluated on the same history introduce look-ahead / in-sample bias; hypothetical daily rebalancing omits turnover costs. Fractional support is assumed. One whole share of each would cost $1534.635, above the $1,000 budget; the displayed whole-share cash is a mechanical floor of each target, not an optimized whole-share alternative.

Equal dollars remain a transparent benchmark. The lower same-history volatility is not proof of future improvement and does not override the missing forward-sizing inputs or substitute for a valuation thesis.

DLC — modeled / simulated analytical lenses

Eight ways to examine the same decision

Simulated analytical lens based on the repository playbook; not a quotation, current view, endorsement or advice from the named investor.

Simulated lens 01 · 200 words

Scott Galloway

GOOG's lower volatility sustains research preference; PLTR remains least preferred for this hypothetical $1,000, twelve-month exercise. The card's diversification test rejects five technology names as diversified wealth, while its glamour-tax test demands cash economics rather than excitement.

Native historical Sharpe is 0.969065 for GOOG and 1.260962 for PLTR, using population volatility and an assumed 0% cash benchmark. PLTR's advantage challenges the boring-is-better instinct; GOOG wins neither a return contest nor immunity from its negative $9.1bn quarterly free cash flow. META also consumed cash; CRWD and AVGO lack inspected fundamentals.

Equal-dollar Sharpe 1.429836 exceeds inverse-volatility 1.383601 despite higher volatility. Lower turbulence is not better efficiency. Conditional portfolio Kelly produces a $971.64 stock sleeve and $28.36 cash, retaining original relative weights, not optimizing them. These are analyst illustrations, not approvals.

The 4,000-trial in-sample joint bootstrap assumes 252 sessions, 21-session blocks, and historical persistence; its probabilities are not calibrated future odds. GOOG's 30% capped reference violates the card's 3–5% wealth discipline if mistaken for a whole fortune. Full Kelly permits no borrowing.

Unnormalized Fed quotes warrant rate sensitivity, not panic. PLTR's 96% revenue growth is substantial counterevidence. Sustained GOOG cash deterioration or independently verified PLTR valuation and cash durability would reverse this ranking.

FIN-F02 reuses 500 returns in 4,000 joint moving-block trials, 252-session horizon, 21-session blocks, seed20261105: modeled payoffs, not calibrated forward odds or independent confirmation. Macro quotes describe forecasted events, not company payoffs. Strongest countercase: GOOG capex destroys owner cash, while PLTR’s operating scale justifies expectations. Change preference after inspected filings reconcile capex and dilution and conservative reverse DCF favors PLTR. FIN-F05’s higher equal-dollar Sharpe defeats automatic preference for inverse-volatility weights; neither comparison validates deployment.

Simulated lens 08 · 200 words

Ed Thorp

Prefer CRWD for risk-screening research; META is least preferred after Sharpe comparison, not a deployment recommendation. FIN-F01’s CRWD Sharpe 1.365799 exceeds META’s 0.326984 at assumed 0% cash using population sigma; 3%/5% sensitivities are modeled benchmarks, not measurements.

Equal-dollar Sharpe 1.429836 exceeds inverse-volatility 1.383601 despite higher volatility. In-sample comparisons do not establish hedged excess returns. FIN-F03’s CRWD full Kelly 4.838779 is conditional arithmetic, not calibrated edge or leverage permission. Quarter Kelly times 0.50 confidence multiplier and 30% stock cap are analyst assumptions, not approval; standalone caps exceed one budget. The $971.64 stock/$28.36 cash sleeve retains inverse-volatility weights, not joint Kelly optimization.

FIN-F02 uses 4,000 joint moving-block trials from 500 returns, 252-session horizon, 21-session blocks, seed20261105. Compressed win/loss averages and shared history supply neither validated forward odds nor independent confirmation. MODEL-F08’s authorization remains false, not its calculation unavailable.

CRWD’s conditional convexity 50.969149 may reflect bullish sampling and four-state compression, not hedge protection. MODEL-F03 rejects PLTR, AVGO and GOOG fits; CRWD nonrejection proves nothing. Missing CRWD/AVGO primary fundamentals and valuations weaken selection; META/GOOG negative quarterly cash flows challenge historical screens. Macro quotes cannot calibrate stock odds. Strongest countercase: CRWD’s edge disappears after costs. Change stance after preregistered walk-forward hedged testing establishes excess returns.

Provenance · measured work

Count evidence—not confidence

measured / calculate — artifact metrology. Five exact ticker captures; 501 completed bars each; 26 verified stock raw-response hashes; six valid actual Polymarket screenshots totaling 1,250,422 bytes; one invalid blank-tab capture retained but excluded. The ledger registers 28 URLs, not 28 independent sources. Macro page/API and company-publisher relationships are disclosed.

No measured per-response token usage, cache receipts or provider-dollar costs were supplied; cost and token savings are unavailable, not zero. Screenshot bytes are not token counts. Layout follows the supplied Satori report/web guidance alongside Monocle-inspired editorial tokens; Plantin is not presumed installed. File fidelity, model replay and a visual/layout review are separate acceptance checks.

13

Conclusion · uncertainty · change triggers

Structure the question before committing capital

Core math actually executed. Historical Sharpe, conditional Kelly and scenario convexity now come from real plugin outputs, with cases and formula hashes. The previous report omitted that central requirement. The new calculations inform the benchmark and sleeve comparisons; they do not validate the historical input model or authorize an investment.

modeled · Editorial reading

Before capital moves

Held-out evidence, cash-flow reconciliation, explicit forward assumptions and implementation constraints come before any real action.

Decision status: RESEARCH ONLY. The report offers a reproducible $1,000 risk-budget illustration, not a buy instruction or financial approval. Page contributes descriptive tail/state diagnostics and limits; eight simulated investor frameworks interpret the same findings rather than voting an edge into existence. Three rejected tail fits, shared data, incomplete fundamentals and non-coherent gasoline quotes remain active counterevidence.

Validation triggers—not automated trading rules
What would change the viewObservable next evidence
Held-out or rolling validationNet-of-cost risk/turnover behavior outside the fitting sample; no result presumed
Valuation and capital intensityComplete company filings, cash-conversion reconciliation and explicit forward assumptions; especially negative META/GOOG quarterly FCF
Tail/regime stabilityAlternative distributions, threshold sensitivity and more observations; do not equate non-rejection with safety
Macro release/contract resolutionObserved official results and contract terms, not just snapshots; keep horizons separate
Implementation and authorizationConfirm fractions, costs, constraints and any separate approval before a real action

Financial facts are source observations; calculations derive from those inputs; model assumptions and simulated commentary remain conditional; future scenarios remain forecasted. Nothing in this document records a transaction or promotes unconfirmed evidence to human approval.

Evidence at a glance

measuredFixed public snapshots

Five quote/history captures and six actual market screenshots; source observations are not human approval.

calculate$1,000 target total

Actual native Sharpe/Kelly/convexity, shares, rounding cash, historical risk and conversions retain input/formula/case bindings.

modeledExplicit conditional inputs

Page tail/state diagnostics and a shared-data bootstrap input model inform real core-engine calculations; neither creates independent forecast validation.

forecastedDifferent event horizons

Macro contracts and conditional stress scenarios describe future outcomes, not observed results.

Read the labels

Observed, derived, assumed and future-facing values are not interchangeable. Unavailable is an evidence state, not a zero.

measured
Observed source data or captured market quotes, with source and as-of time; not automatically user-verified or true about a future event
calculate
Reproducible arithmetic derived from cited inputs: shares, weights, budget totals, conversions and other calculations
modeled
Assumptions, fitted/model-derived diagnostics and conditional analytical interpretations, with methods and limitations
forecasted
Future-facing scenarios and market-implied event outlooks, with explicit horizon and resolution conditions

Limits of the record

  • Fixed, timestamped snapshots—not a live quote feed or executable prices. Provider contractual delay is unknown; independent publisher crosschecks were not simultaneous.
  • The $1,000 budget, twelve-month planning horizon, fractional shares, no borrowing and weight cap are assumptions, not measured personal account constraints.
  • Historical weights and risk comparisons are in-sample/look-ahead with daily rebalancing and omit fees, spreads, taxes and turnover costs.
  • Native Sharpe, Kelly and convexity have now been calculated. Kelly/convexity use conditional in-sample model inputs, not calibrated forward stock odds, authenticated approval or a validated edge. DCF fair values and independent forward payoff estimates remain unavailable.
  • Limited primary company checks cover PLTR/META/GOOG only; CRWD/AVGO full releases remained 403. This is not a full filings or valuation review.
  • All mathematical families share the same adjusted price histories. Persona diversity does not supply independent evidence.
  • Macro events have different horizons. Raw Polymarket contract prices are not normalized joint probabilities or observed economic outcomes.
  • No brokerage access, trades, money movement, private financial records or authenticated human approval.

Portable local artifact. Georgia is an honest local serif fallback; no remote fonts, tracking, account access or live feed.
